verdict.rationale: Autumn publishes an extensive first-party API reference. It covers billing (attach, previewAttach, multiAttach, createSchedule, import, openCustomerPortal), core usage (check, track, trackTokens) and licenses, plus SDK examples, an `atmn api` command that calls any public endpoint, and an llms.txt index for AI consumption. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404), and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of using the API.
